environment.description: ECS Fargate service deployed in isolated private subnets (no NAT gateway, no internet gateway route). Accessible exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint. The VPC endpoint has an endpoint policy that restricts the resource pattern to 'arn:aws:execute-api:*:*:*/*/documents/*' and the principal to specific account roles. The Fargate task uses platform version 1.4.0 with a custom-built distroless container image where the filesystem is read-only (readonlyRootFilesystem: true in task definition) and the container runs as UID 65534 (nobody). The task's EFS mount at /app/documents uses an access point with a POSIX UID/GID enforcement of 1000:1000 and a root directory of /documents. The security group only allows ingress from the VPC endpoint's ENI security group on port 8080. Additionally, a VPC endpoint policy condition restricts requests where the URL path contains '..' sequences via a StringNotLike condition on aws:RequestedPath.

config.subnet_type: isolated (no route to IGW or NAT)
